szoveg_eredeti:
Why does Perplexity have no real competitors? And why are AI valuations inaccurate?

In Episode 2 of AI Decoded, Oliver Howley sits down with Nathan Barksdale , General Counsel and VP of Operations at Perplexity, on how the AI ecosystem actually works from the inside.

Nathan shares why new models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google only make Perplexity stronger, why he believes today’s AI valuations still miss the true scale of the market ahead, and how his legal team of fewer than 10 people runs 50 AI sub-agents per person to operate at startup speed.

Watch the full episode: https://bit.ly/4C1r2NR
